requirements.normative_requirement: The controller state database uses SQLite WAL, synchronous=FULL for D1/D2 authority, foreign keys, trusted_schema=OFF, an assigned application_id, an asserted schema version, and local durable storage.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Partial journal and unsafe extension behavior
requirements.primary_verification: PRAGMA verification and power-loss/fault-injection recovery tests.

requirements.normative_requirement: The database schema enforces client, lease, call, reservation, export, and critical-event relationships.
requirements.primary_verification: Constraint/property tests and malformed migration attempts.

requirements.normative_requirement: No successful D1 call result is returned before its terminal disposition transaction is durable; D0 reads do not require per-call durable database writes.
requirements.primary_verification: Inject commit/fsync failure after process completion.

requirements.normative_requirement: The daemon maintains an emergency storage reserve and stops admission before journal ENOSPC.
requirements.primary_verification: Disk-fill test consuming ordinary free space while preserving reserve.

requirements.normative_requirement: Recovery classifies admitted/started calls without terminal records as unknown and quarantines affected writable leases.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Silent replay or false success after crash
requirements.primary_verification: Kill daemon at every durable state and restart.
